Shipping and returns: Add shippingDetails (OfferShippingDetails: shippingRate, shippingDestination, deliveryTime) and hasMerchantReturnPolicy (applicableCountry, returnPolicyCategory, merchantReturnDays), on the Offer or once on your Organization, so Google can show them with the listing.
Product title length: Make the title more descriptive: brand, product type and the attribute shoppers search for (colour, size, model), e.g. "Allbirds Men's Tree Runner, Navy".
Review markup: Add aggregateRating (ratingValue, reviewCount) and review to the Product, from the ratings the page shows, so search results can show stars.
